summary: Iteration 91: Comprehensive testing of 3-level Expense Intelligence feature (Daily/Weekly/Monthly views with 4-way toggle). All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly - View toggle with 4 options (List/Daily/Weekly/Monthly), List view with month selector and expense cards, Daily view with calendar grid and month selector, Weekly view with summary card (total/weekday/weekend split), day-by-day chart, 8-week trend, behavior insights, drill-down on bar click. Monthly view with summary card (total/% of income/-21.4% change), 6-month trend (Jan '26 orange as highest), category breakdown (Essential/Lifestyle/Wealth stacked bars), insights section, stats row (Avg Monthly/Highest Month), month drill-down with detail.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user data with expenses across categories
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense Intelligence 3-level views fully implemented and tested. MyExpenses page has 4-way toggle (List/Daily/Weekly/Monthly) in the orange/red gradient header. List view shows month selector + expense cards as before. Daily view shows embedded ExpenseCalendar with calendar grid. Weekly view shows summary card with weekday/weekend split, 'This Week by Day' bar chart (Mon-Sun), '8-Week Trend' bar chart (clickable for drill-down showing week detail with day breakdown), behavior insights section. Monthly view shows summary card with current month total + % of income + change vs last month, '6-Month Trend' bar chart (highest month in orange), 'Category Breakdown' stacked bars (Essential blue/Lifestyle orange/Wealth green), 'Intelligence' insights (max 3), stats row (Avg Monthly/Highest Month). Backend APIs: GET /api/expenses/monthly-summary?last=6 and GET /api/expenses/weekly-summary?last=8 both return aggregated data with insights.
